name: vaccination_by_village
description: Monthly vaccination summary per village: one row per village (fixed strategy), then an 'AVANCEE' (outreach) label row and the outreach villages; one column per vaccine.
notes: Line positions are shares of the table: 0 = its left (or top) border, 1 = its right (or bottom) border, so the template does not depend on the photo size.
Positions were estimated by eye from the source photo (about +-0.01); the grid fit adjusts them to each photo.
The 20 vaccine columns are drawn about equally wide. Their names are written sideways in the header and still need to be filled in (vaccine_01 = leftmost).
The vaccine part of the AVANCEE row seems to have no vertical lines (one merged cell); to check on other photos.
